title: Wren and the Salt
author: Cyrus Yarrow
blurb: Orsen Iversen, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
